paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 7.47 as of 2026-08-12, with a change of 4.89 percent compared to the prior close and 18.35 percent over a window of 23 sessions. There has been one new news item in the last 24 hours.

Recent news includes a headline from Seeking Alpha on 2026-08-11, stating that Fermi rises on a deal to add 2.6 GW power capacity at its Texas AI campus. The deal is an agreement with Hillcore Energy Capital in which Hillcore will finance, build, own, and operate the 2.6 GW Hillcore Power Center at Fermi.

There have been various SEC filings, including an 8-K filing on 2026-07-23 announcing the appointment of four new officers, and an 8-K filing on 2026-07-15 disclosing the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031. Additionally, there was one Form 4 filing and 16 proxy solicitation filings, with a total of 25 filings in the feed.
